findings.summary: The child-table plans name fields but do not define typed field schemas.
findings.required_action: Define a closed field specification for each child relation, including value type and applicable unit/state constraints, and test every declared relation/field shape.

findings.summary: Mandatory provenance is modeled separately but is not attached to each declared child field.
findings.required_action: Represent provenance/state/value requirements per declared field and extend the named test to reject any child schema with an unprovenanced field.

findings.summary: Stable child identity uniqueness is not given a precise key or correction rule.
findings.required_action: Specify the stable identity correction behavior and exact uniqueness scope before KL-013 consumes this contract.
